notes.title: DEV SUMMARY JULY2025
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446294/e0a4ec5f2c34fe6cb3711da9878b7593fe357295.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]“Make Us Whole” has reached its 25th week of development[/h2][p]The main meat of the work has been creating levels to populate the Labyrinth, reworking the monster functionality, and creating anomalies.[/p][p][/p][h3]"The Guts" Sector[/h3][p]The raw room structures for the first sector are now complete. They now need to be finalized by adding spawn points, extra details, and general greeble.[/p][p][/p][h3]Retro-Visual Upgrade[/h3][p]The visuals have been retro-overhauled; textures have been dithered and pixelated, post-processing has been adjusted, and fog has been made thicker and more oppressive.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's next?[/h3][p]As the month comes to an end, I am finishing the kitbash for the next sector, and beginning work on reworking the gunplay and creating more weaponry.[/p][p][i]- Director JIN[/i][/p]

notes.title: Retro Horror Motion
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=1xMlfldSTSA;full][/previewyoutube]
Animation Curves are an under-discussed topic in game development. They are a strong tool, that when combined with Coroutines and Lerping, offer easy-to-change motion control. This allows for simple yet strong motion design.

The main uses of Animation Curves in “MakeUsWhole” so far, are gun motion, monster mirco-movements, and simple interaction motions.

notes.title: Milestone: +350 Wishlists
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446294/7816485ce9dfe5c27bb5e1960fd55a7d1f8e0181.png[/img]

The Steam Next Fest has earned “Make Us Whole” over 350 wishlists and 25 feedback forms on Google forms. Thank you to everyone that wishlisted, played the demo, and left your thoughts.

This marks the 7th Week of development. Up until now, the main focus has been mechanics and features. After taking a long weekend off, I will be returning to work on the design. This means:

[list]
[*]Level Design: Room Structure, Interactables (such as doors and levers), Variations, and Generation Patterns
[*]Monster Design: Monsters that fit the new levels, improving the old monsters, and improving general behaviour
[*]Gunplay: Improving gun-feel, sound design, and hitmarkers
[/list]

It’s a long wait until the next Steam Festival, so we intend to release an update for the demo some time between now and June. We look forward to seeing you then.

Until then, take care.
[i]Director JIN[/i]

notes.title: Next Fest Feedback!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446294/ca04b32c7005818d99c95a146154cd0b3a88c0e3.png[/img]

We’ve been getting plenty of feedback via the google forms offered at the end of the demo. Thank you so much for everyone offering your thoughts and opinions on the current state of the game.

This is vital. Feedback this early lets me know what is working and what is not. Once the festival is finished, I will return to all the feedback and review it again. Currently I’m focusing on refactoring the level generation code so I can vigorously test everything without constraint.

Humbly proud,
Director JIN
